title: Bakery landing page
name: bakery
prompt: Make a one-page website for my neighbourhood bakery, Crumb & Co. Show our opening hours (Tue-Sat 7am-3pm, Sun 8am-1pm, closed Monday), a short menu of breads and pastries with prices, our address at 12 Mill Lane, and a phone number. Warm colours, works on phones.

answers: It's just an information page, no ordering. Anyone can see it.

edits: Change Sunday hours to 8am-2pm and add a 'Seasonal specials' section with three items.
Add a small contact section at the bottom with our email, hello@crumb.example.
